title: Patronage
body:
**Patronage** introduces the ultimate end-game armour set that improves as you play the game. Instead of just giving you flat stats, this armour tracks your journey, rewarding your exploration, combat progression, and survival with permanent upgrades.

Key Features:
- **Helmet**: Unlocks permanent **Night Vision**, **Saturation**, and **Ore X-Ray**.
- **Chestplate**: Dynamically increases your **Armour**, **Attack Damage**, and **Max Health**. Reach the ultimate milestone to unlock **Creative Flight**.
- **Leggings**: Grants scaling **Movement Speed** and **Swim Speed** tiers, plus permanent **Step Assist**.
- **Boots**: Grants **Fall Damage Nullification** and  **Dodge Chance** against all incoming damage.
- **Full Set Bonus**: Wear the complete set to trigger an **Hourly Enchant Upgrade** that automatically increases the level of a random enchantment on your armour every 60 minutes!
